atAGlance.value: Jambukeswarar — Shiva as the water element

paragraphs: Jambukeswarar Temple at Thiruvanaikaval, near Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, is one of the Pancha Bhoota Sthalams — the five Shiva temples representing the classical elements — where Shiva is worshipped as the element of water (Appu). The lingam in the sanctum stands over an underground spring, and the sanctum floor remains perpetually wet.

The temple, attributed to the early Chola king Kocengannan, is celebrated for its five prakaras, its shrine to the goddess Akilandeswari, and the unique noon ritual in which the priest, dressed as the goddess, performs worship to Jambukeswarar.
